chars.SISTER: a Moroccan young woman about 20, long dark wavy hair in a low ponytail, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and grey joggers
chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman in her late 40s wearing a burgundy djellaba and a light beige headscarf, carrying a black handbag
chars.BROTHER: a Moroccan boy about 10 wearing a red football jersey and black shorts, holding a smartphone
chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 22, short black hair, wearing a navy zip hoodie with a white chest stripe and dark jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night in a Moroccan apartment salon with traditional sedari banquettes. SISTER sits stiffly on the banquette, biting her nails, eyes fixed nervously on the front door, seen head-to-waist from the doorway where her brother stands. Anxious, guilty expression, warm lamp light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: The front door of a Moroccan apartment opens at night; MOM steps in with her handbag, smiling tiredly and raising a hand to greet the family. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, hallway with zellige tiles behind her.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan salon at night MOM bends to kiss BROTHER on the head while he keeps staring at his phone screen, sitting on the banquette. Warm, ordinary family moment, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan salon at night MOM, still in her djellaba, looks around puzzled and asks SISTER a question, palm open; SISTER sits frozen on the banquette, glancing sideways in panic. Both faces visible, tense atmosphere.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan salon at night SISTER bursts into tears, hands near her face but face visible, while MOM stands in front of her stunned and frozen, eyes wide with worry. Dramatic but not violent, warm lamp light.
